title: Mankiyali language - Wikipedia
text: Mankiyali is an endangered Indo-Aryan language of the Dardic [3][4] sub-branch spoken in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, northern Pakistan. It is spoken by a small community sometimes referred to as the Trawara [5] in the secluded village of Danna (or Dana) located in the Bandi Shungli union council of Mansehra District. [6]
